concerns.text: Principle VII in the constitution specifies permutation testing by shuffling polarization values to momentum bins, but the plan implements a permutation test that shuffles study labels on scalar upper‑limit data. This does not satisfy the literal requirement of Principle VII.

Several contract schemas (d_measurement.schema.yaml, dataset.schema.yaml, fusion_result.schema.yaml, meta_analysis_result.schema.yaml, output.schema.yaml, raw_observable.schema.yaml) are defined in the contracts directory but no plan phase references or exercises them, violating the rule that every contract must be exercised by at least one plan element.
